args.title: Warehouse Automation 2026 — Tamarack article + companion summary
args.body:
Combined summary of Tamarack's "Warehouse automation in 2026" article and its subscriber companion piece:

- Autonomous carts lifted pick rates by 18%.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Sources:
- https://blog.tamarack.example/2026/warehouse
- https://insights.tamarack.example/warehouse/companion (accessed with team subscription code SUB-3455)
